name: Weston
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Weston, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Weston, FL: Weston Town Center tree lighting, Noche de Velitas at Regional Park and a free Symphony in the Park holiday concert.
lede: Weston celebrates outdoors: a Town Center tree lighting on Thanksgiving weekend, a big Noche de Velitas festival at Regional Park and a free holiday symphony on the park lawn.
celebrates: Weston Town Center kicks off the season with its annual Christmas Tree Lighting Show on Market Street. At Weston Regional Park, Americas Community Center hosts Noche de Velitas, Gaitas y Verbenas, a free festival with live entertainment, children's activities, a holiday bazaar and food. The City of Weston and the Weston Music Society present Symphony in the Park: Holiday Favorites, a free outdoor concert with the South Florida Symphony Orchestra, holiday songs from Frozen and The Grinch, Hanukkah melodies and sing-alongs. The Weston Regional Park event stage is the new home of the concert.
lastyear: The City of Weston's holiday guide for 2025 listed Noche de Velitas, Gaitas and Verbena at Weston Regional Park on December 6 from 5 to 10 pm, and the Weston Town Center Christmas Tree Lighting on December 7 from 4 to 8 pm. It also listed Symphony in the Park: Holiday Favorites on December 13 and Chanukah at Weston Town Center on December 14. The 2025 guide pointed families to Winter Wonderland at Flamingo Gardens as well.
facts: Weston was assembled from 15,000 acres first amassed in the 1950s by Arthur Vining Davis, the original owner of the developer Arvida. The Arvida development was first called Indian Trace and was renamed Weston, and the first homes were completed in 1984 in Windmill Ranch and Country Isles. On September 3, 1996, 90 percent of voters in the Indian Trace district chose to incorporate, and Bonaventure voted to join Weston on April 1, 1997.
trains: Weston does not have its own Tri-Rail station. Tri-Rail's Broward stops include Cypress Creek, Fort Lauderdale and Sheridan Street, and the Fort Lauderdale Airport station is at 500 Gulf Stream Way in Dania. Metrorail and Metromover run in Miami-Dade County. The Americas Community Center's Noche de Velitas festival is on the lawn of Weston Regional Park, so families arrive by car. For a bigger train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has over 40 historic rail cars, including the Presidential Rail Car Ferdinand Magellan and Florida East Coast Steam Locomotive #153.
train_links: Over 40 historic rail cars, including the Presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and Florida East Coast steam locomotive #153, in Miami.
traditions: Weston Town Center holds an annual Christmas Tree Lighting Show on the Sunday of Thanksgiving weekend.
Americas Community Center hosts a free festival of hope, culture and community with children's activities and live entertainment.
The festival includes holiday shopping, food and a bazaar of vendors.
The South Florida Symphony Orchestra plays holiday favorites at Weston Regional Park.
The city's holiday guide lists a Chanukah event at Town Center in December.
kidfact: Weston was first called Indian Trace. The name changed to Weston before the first families moved in to Windmill Ranch and Country Isles in 1984.
faq: Where is the Weston Christmas tree lighting?

Weston Town Center, 1675 Market Street, holds its annual Christmas Tree Lighting Show. The center asks guests to reserve a free spot on Eventbrite. The event is on the Sunday of Thanksgiving weekend, and the center describes it as a festive holiday gathering that kicks off the season together in person.
Is there a free Christmas event in Weston?

Yes. Noche de Velitas, Gaitas y Verbenas at Weston Regional Park is free to attend, according to Americas Community Center. The City of Weston lists Symphony in the Park: Holiday Favorites as a free outdoor concert, and Weston Town Center lists its tree lighting as free with a reservation.
What is Noche de Velitas in Weston?

It is a community holiday festival hosted by Americas Community Center at Weston Regional Park. The organizer says thousands of families gather for traditional live entertainment, cultural performances, children's activities, holiday shopping and food. Questions go to info@americascc.org or (954) 323-9526.
Where is the Weston holiday symphony concert?

The City of Weston and the Weston Music Society present it at the event stage at Weston Regional Park, 20200 Saddle Club Road, which the city marks as a new location. The city asks families to bring lawn chairs or blankets because limited seating is provided.
How did Weston become a city?

Weston grew from land that the developer Arvida assembled, first as Indian Trace. On September 3, 1996, about 90 percent of voters in the district chose to incorporate, according to the City of Weston. Bonaventure residents voted to join Weston on April 1, 1997.
